coordination_holds_append: The complete project-car/lift group is centred longitudinally at X=5.34 m in the X=0.18–10.50 m technical bay, leaving equal 1.96 m residuals before and after the 6.40 m test envelope.

The usable transverse territory begins at Y=0.93 m after the wall bench and ends at Y=7.00 m before the pedestrian axis. The schematic lift envelope is centred exactly at Y=3.965 m and reduced by 0.03 m in depth to leave equal 0.10 m graphic residuals.
The 4.80 × 2.00 m vehicle symbol and the symmetric post pair share the lift-envelope centre at X=5.34 m, Y=3.965 m. This corrects the predecessor's internal offset as well as the bay offset.
The equal 0.10 m bench and axis gaps are graphic non-overlap values only. They do not establish safe working, escape, door-opening or manufacturer clearances.
